stories.headline: AI investment race faces a revenue test
stories.summary: AI data-center spending could exceed $30 trillion by 2050, but economists say broad productivity gains remain elusive. Bain estimates builders need $4.2 trillion in new revenue within five years; applications may not arrive fast enough.

stories.headline: Trump favors voluntary AI safeguards
stories.summary: A White House pact with six AI companies calls for controls and external auditors but states no penalty for noncompliance. Critics question enforceability; supporters see acknowledgment of safety risks.

stories.headline: US plans $90 payments for 20 million seniors
stories.summary: President Trump said eligible Medicare enrollees will receive a one-time $90 payment in early October from the Medicare Improvement Fund. The White House says payments will arrive by deposit or check.

stories.headline: Russia strikes another major Kyiv bridge
stories.summary: Kyiv's Northern Bridge was damaged in an air attack after repeated strikes on the Southern Bridge. Traffic was suspended; no casualties were reported. Ukraine expects a winter campaign against key infrastructure.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia plans offensive against Houthis
stories.summary: Six sources told Reuters that Riyadh is weighing a coastal or multi-front operation to retake the Bab el-Mandeb route. Timing and scope remain uncertain, and Saudi, Yemeni and Houthi officials did not comment.
